title: Bell state explorer export
description: Snapshot of the Bell State Density Matrix Explorer's current settings and derived measurements, for external validation against the physics formulas documented in this repository's README and CLAUDE.md.

$schema.description: URI of this schema, so validators can dereference it without out-of-band configuration.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this export format, independent of the app's own version.

exportedAt.description: UTC timestamp the export was generated, RFC 3339 / ISO 8601.

q0.description: Input bit for q0 (H+CNOT control). Sets the Bell state's relative phase.

q1.description: Input bit for q1 (H+CNOT target). Sets the Bell state's family (Phi/Psi).

thetaRadians.description: Amplitude balance in radians, 0 to PI/2. PI/4 is maximal entanglement.

rotation0Radians.description: Local R_y rotation angle applied to q0 after Bell-state preparation, in radians.

rotation1Radians.description: Local R_y rotation angle applied to q1 after Bell-state preparation, in radians.

label.description: Unicode ket label for the prepared Bell state, e.g. "|Φ⁺⟩".

equation.description: Canonical Dirac equation for the Bell state, independent of theta/dephasing.

psi.description: true for the Psi family {01,10}, false for the Phi family {00,11}.

negative.description: true if the relative phase between the two branches is minus.

blochVector.description: [rx, ry, rz]. ry is always 0 for this app's real-valued states.

densityMatrix.description: 4x4 real symmetric density matrix, rows/columns ordered 00, 01, 10, 11. Includes any local rotation applied after Bell-state preparation.

concurrence.description: Entanglement measure of the pre-rotation Bell state; local rotations preserve it.

purity.description: Tr(rho^2) of the post-rotation state. 1 for pure; 0.5 is this family's fully-dephased floor.

outcomeProbabilities.description: Diagonal of the density matrix, in basis order 00, 01, 10, 11.
